checklist.why: Counting animals; Measure named for measured values
The don'ts name Measure and forbid typing a count
Label, description, keys, value and status line named
The DS row and hero faces are used by no screen; screens use the TaskStepper faces (row, well, count)
Default, empty, pressed, floor-gray, focus, corrected and draft rendered
Keys 46 wide (DS), 44 wide (TaskStepper row), 44x44 in the farrowing forks; pointer text actions 44 tall
No cap on stacked steppers per sheet
Draft (green) and corrected (amber) differ by colour only
Label of 14 characters or fewer stated
spinbutton, aria-valuenow/min/max, status region, arrow keys
Tokens throughout; only 1-3px borders and offsets are raw
Not a text field; no typed counts
Candidate status and ADR link; TaskStepper links back
375 render of every state, no overflow

variants.name: row (DS face, filled ink +)
findings: The reserved 44px hint line leaves uneven gaps under the first rows of a stack

variants.name: hero (DS face)
findings: No screen uses it; farrowing.count hand-rolls .hero-stepper

variants.name: TaskStepper row face
findings: Keys are 44px wide, below the 48 floor

variants.name: TaskStepper well/count faces
findings: The count face colours + green, which the Stepper README forbids until the owner decides

findings.text: Key widths are below the glove floor: 46px (DS face), 44px (TaskStepper row face), 44x44 (farrowing .row-stepper forks). Pointer text actions are 44px tall.
findings.fix: Set the key face to 48px (control-height) in every face, and text actions to min-height 48.

findings.text: Farrowing still hand-rolls three look-alikes (.row-stepper on death and edit, .hero-stepper on count, .feature-stepper on foster and reconcile) instead of SentriTask.stepper.
findings.fix: Swap them for the SentriTask.stepper faces row, count and well, and delete the forks.

findings.text: No screen uses the DS faces (filled ink +); task pages use other faces. Two looks for one job, with no stated rule.
findings.fix: List the faces (row, well, count) as this card's variants, and retire the filled-ink face or name a screen that needs it.

findings.text: Draft (green value) and corrected (amber value) are colour-only.
findings.fix: Add a word in the status line ("+1 unsaved", "corrected") alongside the colour.

findings.text: The reserved 44px hint line opens uneven gaps in a stack where only some rows can show pointers.
findings.fix: Reserve per sheet, not per row: in a stack, rows without pointers take reserveHint:false.
